fusions.name: Bulk Behind the Blow
fusions.desc: A lunging blow at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 28 damage, ignoring armour, rising to 1.5 times that at full range. It leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Barge Through
fusions.desc: You barge through, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and knocking them 3.5 tiles back. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Winter Fat
fusions.desc: Restores 30 stamina and 10 health to you at once.

fusions.name: Settling Weight
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
